name: SAC 7-Day Appeal Limitation Cutoff Escalation
description: Statutory escalation executed strictly at the conclusion of 7 calendar days (23:59:59 UTC) from upload of speaking order of rejection under APH Clause 2.24(a). Permanently locks case and extinguishes administrative appeal.

tiers.description: Statutory Cutoff: 7 calendar days expired without appeal filing. Case permanently locked from statutory appeal.
tiers.actionRequired: Lock case; record statutory forfeiture of administrative appeal.

autoResolutionCondition: Appeal filed within 7 calendar days or case permanently locked.
